data.one_liner: Push notifications in Flutter without firebase_messaging for Android, iOS and macOS.
data.what_it_does: Handles push notifications including background notifications, alert notifications, and notification taps across Android, iOS, and macOS. Allows avoiding Firebase on iOS and macOS by using APNs directly.
use_when: You do not or cannot use Firebase Messaging (FCM) on iOS
You need push notifications on Android, iOS, and macOS with consistent behavior
You want to handle push notifications when the app is in the foreground, background, or terminated
avoid_when: You are already using firebase_messaging and have no issues with it
You need advanced FCM-specific features like FCM message IDs or sender fields
strengths: Avoids using Firebase on iOS and macOS
Consistent behavior between iOS and Android
Handles push notifications in foreground, background, and terminated states
weaknesses: Lowest common denominator API due to platform differences
Setup is more difficult than standard packages due to native configuration requirements
Does not provide FCM message IDs or sender fields on platforms that do not use FCM
data.setup_notes: Requires native configuration such as adding google-services.json for Android, Apple Developer Program membership for iOS/macOS push keys, and specific delegate forwards in macOS AppDelegate.

alternatives.name: firebase_messaging
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want standard Firebase messaging support across all platforms and do not mind using Firebase on iOS.
